---
---

<header class="hero">
<div class="eyebrow"><span class="live-dot"></span> FLORIDA MIGRATION, NATIVITY &amp; DEMOGRAPHICS</div>
<h1>Florida in motion.</h1>
<p class="hero-copy">Investigate migration flows, foreign-born populations, ethnicity, and economic conditions across all 67 Florida counties from 2010 to 2024—and click any county to explore its individual Census tracts.</p>
<div class="hero-meta"><span>67 Florida counties</span><span class="meta-divider">/</span><span>5,160 Census tracts</span><span class="meta-divider">/</span><span>2010–2024 ACS 5-Year Estimates</span></div>
</header>

<div class="dashboard-content">
<section class="control-panel" aria-label="Dashboard controls">
<div class="year-control">
<div class="control-heading">
<label for="year-slider">Travel through time</label>
<output id="year-label" for="year-slider">2024</output>
</div>
<input id="year-slider" type="range" min="2010" max="2024" value="2024" step="1" aria-label="Select ACS estimate ending year">
<div class="slider-ends"><span>2010</span><span>2024</span></div>
</div>
<button id="play-button" class="play-button" type="button" aria-label="Play through years">
<span aria-hidden="true">▶</span><span id="play-label">Play</span>
</button>
<div class="metric-control">
<label for="county-select">Selected Florida county</label>
<select id="county-select" aria-label="Select a Florida county"></select>
</div>
<div class="metric-control">
<label for="metric-select">Explore a measure</label>
<select id="metric-select">
<optgroup label="Migration Patterns (Past 12 Months)">
<option value="in_migration_percent">New arrivals from outside county (%)</option>
<option value="moved_from_other_state_percent">Moved from a different U.S. state (%)</option>
<option value="moved_from_other_county_percent">Moved from another Florida county (%)</option>
<option value="moved_from_abroad_percent">Moved from abroad (%)</option>
<option value="moved_within_county_percent">Moved within same county (%)</option>
<option value="same_house_percent">Same house 1 year ago (%)</option>
</optgroup>
<optgroup label="Foreign-Born &amp; Citizenship">
<option value="foreign_born_percent">Foreign-born population (%)</option>
<option value="foreign_born">Foreign-born population (count)</option>
<option value="naturalized_citizen_percent">Naturalized U.S. citizens (%)</option>
<option value="non_citizen_percent">Non-U.S. citizens (%)</option>
</optgroup>
<optgroup label="Ethnicity &amp; Race">
<option value="hispanic_percent" selected>Hispanic or Latino (%)</option>
<option value="white_non_hispanic_percent">White, non-Hispanic (%)</option>
<option value="black_non_hispanic_percent">Black, non-Hispanic (%)</option>
<option value="asian_non_hispanic_percent">Asian, non-Hispanic (%)</option>
</optgroup>
<optgroup label="Economic Conditions &amp; Population">
<option value="median_household_income">Median household income ($)</option>
<option value="poverty_rate_percent">People below poverty level (%)</option>
<option value="unemployment_rate_percent">Unemployment rate (%)</option>
<option value="median_gross_rent">Median gross rent ($)</option>
<option value="median_home_value">Median home value ($)</option>
<option value="population">Total population</option>
</optgroup>
</select>
</div>
</section>

<p id="year-note" class="year-note" aria-live="polite"></p>

<section class="stat-grid" aria-label="Selected county highlights">
<article class="stat-card stat-primary">
<span class="stat-label" id="current-label">SARASOTA COUNTY · 2024</span>
<strong class="stat-value" id="current-value">—</strong>
<span class="stat-detail" id="metric-name">New arrivals from outside county (%)</span>
</article>
<article class="stat-card">
<span class="stat-label">CHANGE SINCE 2010</span>
<strong class="stat-value" id="change-value">—</strong>
<span class="stat-detail" id="change-detail">Compared with the 2010 estimate</span>
</article>
<article class="stat-card">
<span class="stat-label">VS. STATE OF FLORIDA</span>
<strong class="stat-value" id="state-value">—</strong>
<span class="stat-detail" id="state-detail">Difference from statewide estimate</span>
</article>
<article class="stat-card">
<span class="stat-label">VS. UNITED STATES</span>
<strong class="stat-value" id="us-value">—</strong>
<span class="stat-detail" id="us-detail">Difference from national estimate</span>
</article>
</section>

<section class="chart-card" aria-labelledby="map-heading">
<div class="section-heading">
<div>
<p class="section-kicker">INTERACTIVE GEOGRAPHY · COUNTY TO CENSUS TRACT</p>
<h2 id="map-heading">Click any Florida county to inspect its Census tracts</h2>
</div>
<span class="chart-note" id="map-badge">Sarasota County selected</span>
</div>
<div class="map-grid">
<div class="map-panel">
<div class="map-panel-header">
<div class="map-panel-title">Florida Counties (<span id="county-map-year">2024</span>)</div>
<span class="map-panel-sub" id="county-hover-label">Click a county to drill down</span>
</div>
<div id="fl-county-map" class="map-stage" role="img" aria-label="Interactive map of Florida counties"></div>
<div class="map-scale">
<span id="county-scale-min">—</span>
<span class="scale-bar"></span>
<span id="county-scale-max">—</span>
</div>
</div>
<div class="map-panel">
<div class="map-panel-header">
<div class="map-panel-title" id="tract-map-title">Sarasota County Census Tracts (2024)</div>
<span class="map-panel-sub" id="tract-count-label">— tracts</span>
</div>
<div id="county-tract-map" class="map-stage" role="img" aria-label="Interactive map of Census tracts in the selected Florida county"></div>
<div class="map-scale">
<span id="tract-scale-min">—</span>
<span class="scale-bar"></span>
<span id="tract-scale-max">—</span>
</div>
<div class="tract-readout" id="tract-readout">
<div class="tract-readout-title">
<span id="tract-detail-name">Hover or click a Census tract</span>
<span id="tract-detail-primary">—</span>
</div>
<div class="tract-metrics-mini">
<div>In-migration<strong id="td-migration">—</strong></div>
<div>Foreign-born<strong id="td-foreign">—</strong></div>
<div>Hispanic / Latino<strong id="td-hispanic">—</strong></div>
<div>Median income<strong id="td-income">—</strong></div>
<div>Poverty rate<strong id="td-poverty">—</strong></div>
<div>Population<strong id="td-pop">—</strong></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</section>

<section class="chart-card" aria-labelledby="trend-heading">
<div class="section-heading">
<div>
<p class="section-kicker">COUNTY · STATE · COUNTRY COMPARISON (2010–2024)</p>
<h2 id="trend-heading">How the selected county compares over time</h2>
</div>
<span class="chart-note">ACS 5-year estimates</span>
</div>
<div id="trend-chart" class="chart-wrap" role="img" aria-label="Trend chart comparing selected county, Florida, and the United States"></div>
<div id="trend-legend" class="legend" aria-label="Chart legend"></div>
</section>

<section class="chart-card comparison-card" aria-labelledby="comparison-heading">
<div class="section-heading">
<div>
<p class="section-kicker">NEIGHBORHOOD BREAKDOWN</p>
<h2 id="comparison-heading">Top Census tracts in Sarasota County</h2>
</div>
<span class="chart-note">2024 tract estimates · Click a tract to highlight on map</span>
</div>
<p class="comparison-copy" id="comparison-copy">Showing the top 15 Census tracts in the selected county for this measure. Click any row to highlight that tract on the map above.</p>
<div id="comparison-chart" class="comparison-list" role="img" aria-label="Top Census tracts in the selected county"></div>
</section>

<footer class="source-note">
<strong>Reading the data</strong>
<p>Data is organized across three geographic levels: <code>county/</code> (Census tracts across Florida counties), <code>state/</code> (all 67 Florida counties and statewide totals, 2010–2024), and <code>country/</code> (United States national totals, 2010–2024). Estimates come from the U.S. Census Bureau's American Community Survey (ACS) 5-year releases (`B07001` for migration, `B05002` for nativity and citizenship, `B03002` for race and Hispanic origin, and `B19013`, `B17001`, `B23025`, `B25064`, `B25077` for economic conditions).</p>
</footer>
</div>

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

fl_state <- readr::read_csv(
  "state/florida_migration_acs.csv",
  col_types = readr::cols(GEOID = "c"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    short_name = sub(" County, Florida$|, Florida$", "", name)
  )

us_national <- readr::read_csv(
  "country/us_migration_acs.csv",
  col_types = readr::cols(GEOID = "c"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  dplyr::filter(level == "us") |>
  dplyr::mutate(short_name = "United States")

fl_tracts <- readr::read_csv(
  "county/florida_tracts_2024.csv",
  col_types = readr::cols(GEOID = "c", county_geoid = "c"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    short_name = sub(";.*$", "", name),
    dplyr::across(
      -c(GEOID, county_geoid, name, level, year, short_name, population, foreign_born),
      \(x) dplyr::if_else(population < 100, NA_real_, x)
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(-name, -level, -year)

counties_geojson <- paste(readLines("state/florida_counties.geojson", warn = FALSE), collapse = "\n")

cat(
  '<script id="fl-series-data" type="application/json">',
  jsonlite::toJSON(
    dplyr::bind_rows(fl_state, us_national) |> dplyr::select(-name),
    dataframe = "rows",
    na = "null",
    auto_unbox = TRUE,
    digits = 2
  ),
  "</script>\n"
)

cat(
  '<script id="fl-tracts-data" type="application/json">',
  jsonlite::toJSON(
    fl_tracts,
    dataframe = "rows",
    na = "null",
    auto_unbox = TRUE,
    digits = 2
  ),
  "</script>\n"
)

cat('<script id="fl-counties-geojson" type="application/json">', counties_geojson, "</script>\n")
```

<script>
(() => {
  const seriesData = JSON.parse(document.getElementById("fl-series-data").textContent);
  const tractsData = JSON.parse(document.getElementById("fl-tracts-data").textContent);
  const countiesGeo = JSON.parse(document.getElementById("fl-counties-geojson").textContent);

  const tractByGeoid = new Map(tractsData.map(row => [row.GEOID, row]));
  let tractsGeo = null;
  let selectedCountyGeoid = "12115"; // Default: Sarasota County
  let selectedTractGeoid = null;
  let playTimer;

  const metrics = {
    in_migration_percent: { label: "New arrivals from outside county (%)", kind: "percent" },
    moved_from_other_state_percent: { label: "Moved from a different U.S. state (%)", kind: "percent" },
    moved_from_other_county_percent: { label: "Moved from another Florida county (%)", kind: "percent" },
    moved_from_abroad_percent: { label: "Moved from abroad (%)", kind: "percent" },
    moved_within_county_percent: { label: "Moved within same county (%)", kind: "percent" },
    same_house_percent: { label: "Same house 1 year ago (%)", kind: "percent" },
    foreign_born_percent: { label: "Foreign-born population (%)", kind: "percent" },
    foreign_born: { label: "Foreign-born population (count)", kind: "number" },
    naturalized_citizen_percent: { label: "Naturalized U.S. citizens (%)", kind: "percent" },
    non_citizen_percent: { label: "Non-U.S. citizens (%)", kind: "percent" },
    hispanic_percent: { label: "Hispanic or Latino (%)", kind: "percent" },
    white_non_hispanic_percent: { label: "White, non-Hispanic (%)", kind: "percent" },
    black_non_hispanic_percent: { label: "Black, non-Hispanic (%)", kind: "percent" },
    asian_non_hispanic_percent: { label: "Asian, non-Hispanic (%)", kind: "percent" },
    median_household_income: { label: "Median household income ($)", kind: "currency" },
    poverty_rate_percent: { label: "People below poverty level (%)", kind: "percent" },
    unemployment_rate_percent: { label: "Unemployment rate (%)", kind: "percent", start: 2011 },
    median_gross_rent: { label: "Median gross rent ($)", kind: "currency" },
    median_home_value: { label: "Median home value ($)", kind: "currency" },
    population: { label: "Total population", kind: "number" }
  };

  const slider = document.getElementById("year-slider");
  const countySelect = document.getElementById("county-select");
  const metricSelect = document.getElementById("metric-select");
  const playButton = document.getElementById("play-button");

  // Populate Florida county dropdown alphabetically
  const countyList = Array.from(
    new Map(
      seriesData
        .filter(r => r.level === "county")
        .map(r => [r.GEOID, r.short_name])
    ).entries()
  ).sort((a, b) => a[1].localeCompare(b[1]));

  countyList.forEach(([geoid, name]) => {
    const opt = document.createElement("option");
    opt.value = geoid;
    opt.textContent = `${name} County`;
    if (geoid === selectedCountyGeoid) opt.selected = true;
    countySelect.append(opt);
  });

  const countyName = geoid => {
    const match = countyList.find(([id]) => id === geoid);
    return match ? `${match[1]} County` : "Selected County";
  };

  const rowsForGeoid = (geoid, key) => seriesData
    .filter(row => row.GEOID === geoid && Number.isFinite(row[key]))
    .sort((a, b) => a.year - b.year);

  const rowAtGeoid = (geoid, year) => seriesData.find(
    row => row.GEOID === geoid && row.year === year
  );

  const format = (value, kind, compact = false) => {
    if (!Number.isFinite(value)) return "—";
    if (kind === "percent") return `${value.toFixed(1)}%`;
    if (kind === "currency") {
      return new Intl.NumberFormat("en-US", {
        style: "currency",
        currency: "USD",
        maximumFractionDigits: 0,
        notation: compact ? "compact" : "standard"
      }).format(value);
    }
    return new Intl.NumberFormat("en-US", {
      maximumFractionDigits: 0,
      notation: compact ? "compact" : "standard"
    }).format(value);
  };

  const signed = value => `${value > 0 ? "+" : ""}${value.toFixed(1)}%`;
  const text = (id, value) => {
    const el = document.getElementById(id);
    if (el) el.textContent = value;
  };

  const svgNode = (name, attributes = {}) => {
    const node = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", name);
    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(attributes)) node.setAttribute(key, value);
    return node;
  };

  // Color interpolation for choropleth maps
  const colorRamp = [
    [231, 239, 233],
    [126, 177, 166],
    [43, 111, 106],
    [214, 91, 66]
  ];

  function interpolateColor(t) {
    if (!Number.isFinite(t)) return "#eceee9";
    const clamped = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, t));
    const scaled = clamped * (colorRamp.length - 1);
    const idx = Math.min(colorRamp.length - 2, Math.floor(scaled));
    const frac = scaled - idx;
    const c0 = colorRamp[idx];
    const c1 = colorRamp[idx + 1];
    const r = Math.round(c0[0] + (c1[0] - c0[0]) * frac);
    const g = Math.round(c0[1] + (c1[1] - c0[1]) * frac);
    const b = Math.round(c0[2] + (c1[2] - c0[2]) * frac);
    return `rgb(${r}, ${g}, ${b})`;
  }

  function extractRings(geometry) {
    if (!geometry) return [];
    if (geometry.type === "Polygon") return [geometry.coordinates];
    if (geometry.type === "MultiPolygon") return geometry.coordinates;
    return [];
  }

  function computeBounds(features) {
    let minLon = Infinity, maxLon = -Infinity, minLat = Infinity, maxLat = -Infinity;
    features.forEach(f => {
      extractRings(f.geometry).forEach(poly => {
        poly.forEach(ring => {
          ring.forEach(([lon, lat]) => {
            if (lon < minLon) minLon = lon;
            if (lon > maxLon) maxLon = lon;
            if (lat < minLat) minLat = lat;
            if (lat > maxLat) maxLat = lat;
          });
        });
      });
    });
    return { minLon, maxLon, minLat, maxLat };
  }

  function geometryToPath(geometry, project) {
    const polys = extractRings(geometry);
    return polys.map(poly =>
      poly.map(ring =>
        ring.map(([lon, lat], i) => {
          const [x, y] = project(lon, lat);
          return `${i === 0 ? "M" : "L"}${x.toFixed(1)},${y.toFixed(1)}`;
        }).join(" ") + " Z"
      ).join(" ")
    ).join(" ");
  }

  function makeProjector(features, width, height, pad = 12) {
    const b = computeBounds(features);
    const midLat = ((b.minLat + b.maxLat) / 2) * (Math.PI / 180);
    const cosLat = Math.cos(midLat) || 1;
    const lonSpan = (b.maxLon - b.minLon) * cosLat || 0.01;
    const latSpan = (b.maxLat - b.minLat) || 0.01;
    const scale = Math.min((width - pad * 2) / lonSpan, (height - pad * 2) / latSpan);
    const drawnW = lonSpan * scale;
    const drawnH = latSpan * scale;
    const offsetX = (width - drawnW) / 2;
    const offsetY = (height - drawnH) / 2;
    return (lon, lat) => [
      offsetX + (lon - b.minLon) * cosLat * scale,
      offsetY + (b.maxLat - lat) * scale
    ];
  }

  function updateTractReadout(tractRow, key, meta) {
    if (!tractRow) {
      text("tract-detail-name", "Hover or click a Census tract on the right map");
      text("tract-detail-primary", "—");
      text("td-migration", "—");
      text("td-foreign", "—");
      text("td-hispanic", "—");
      text("td-income", "—");
      text("td-poverty", "—");
      text("td-pop", "—");
      return;
    }
    text("tract-detail-name", `${tractRow.short_name} (${countyName(tractRow.county_geoid)})`);
    text("tract-detail-primary", `${meta.label}: ${format(tractRow[key], meta.kind)}`);
    text("td-migration", format(tractRow.in_migration_percent, "percent"));
    text("td-foreign", format(tractRow.foreign_born_percent, "percent"));
    text("td-hispanic", format(tractRow.hispanic_percent, "percent"));
    text("td-income", format(tractRow.median_household_income, "currency"));
    text("td-poverty", format(tractRow.poverty_rate_percent, "percent"));
    text("td-pop", format(tractRow.population, "number"));
  }

  function renderCountyMap(key, meta, year) {
    const width = 420, height = 320;
    const svg = svgNode("svg", { viewBox: `0 0 ${width} ${height}` });
    const features = countiesGeo.features;
    const project = makeProjector(features, width, height, 10);

    const valByCounty = new Map();
    seriesData
      .filter(r => r.level === "county" && r.year === year)
      .forEach(r => valByCounty.set(r.GEOID, r[key]));

    const finiteVals = Array.from(valByCounty.values()).filter(Number.isFinite);
    const minVal = finiteVals.length ? Math.min(...finiteVals) : 0;
    const maxVal = finiteVals.length ? Math.max(...finiteVals) : 1;
    const span = (maxVal - minVal) || 1;

    text("county-scale-min", format(minVal, meta.kind, true));
    text("county-scale-max", format(maxVal, meta.kind, true));
    text("county-map-year", year);

    features.forEach(feature => {
      const geoid = feature.properties.GEOID;
      const val = valByCounty.get(geoid);
      const t = Number.isFinite(val) ? (val - minVal) / span : NaN;
      const path = svgNode("path", {
        d: geometryToPath(feature.geometry, project),
        fill: interpolateColor(t),
        class: `map-feature${geoid === selectedCountyGeoid ? " is-active" : ""}`
      });
      const title = svgNode("title");
      title.textContent = `${feature.properties.county_name} County: ${format(val, meta.kind)}`;
      path.append(title);

      path.addEventListener("mouseenter", () => {
        text("county-hover-label", `${feature.properties.county_name} County · ${format(val, meta.kind)}`);
      });
      path.addEventListener("mouseleave", () => {
        text("county-hover-label", "Click a county to drill down");
      });
      path.addEventListener("click", () => {
        selectedCountyGeoid = geoid;
        selectedTractGeoid = null;
        countySelect.value = geoid;
        update();
      });
      svg.append(path);
    });

    svg.querySelectorAll(".map-feature.is-active").forEach(el => svg.append(el));
    const stage = document.getElementById("fl-county-map");
    stage.replaceChildren(svg);
  }

  function renderTractMap(key, meta) {
    const stage = document.getElementById("county-tract-map");
    const cName = countyName(selectedCountyGeoid);
    text("tract-map-title", `${cName} Census Tracts (2024)`);
    text("map-badge", `${cName} selected`);

    const countyTractRows = tractsData.filter(r => r.county_geoid === selectedCountyGeoid);

    if (!tractsGeo) {
      text("tract-count-label", `${countyTractRows.length} Census tracts`);
      stage.textContent = "Loading Census tract boundaries…";
      return;
    }

    const features = tractsGeo.features.filter(f => f.properties.county_geoid === selectedCountyGeoid);
    text("tract-count-label", `${features.length} Census tracts`);
    const width = 440, height = 320;
    const svg = svgNode("svg", { viewBox: `0 0 ${width} ${height}` });
    const project = makeProjector(features, width, height, 12);

    const finiteVals = countyTractRows.map(r => r[key]).filter(Number.isFinite);
    const minVal = finiteVals.length ? Math.min(...finiteVals) : 0;
    const maxVal = finiteVals.length ? Math.max(...finiteVals) : 1;
    const span = (maxVal - minVal) || 1;

    text("tract-scale-min", format(minVal, meta.kind, true));
    text("tract-scale-max", format(maxVal, meta.kind, true));

    // Default readout to highest-value tract in county if none clicked
    const topTract = [...countyTractRows]
      .filter(r => Number.isFinite(r[key]))
      .sort((a, b) => b[key] - a[key])[0];
    const activeTractRow = (selectedTractGeoid && tractByGeoid.get(selectedTractGeoid)) || topTract;
    updateTractReadout(activeTractRow, key, meta);

    features.forEach(feature => {
      const geoid = feature.properties.GEOID;
      const row = tractByGeoid.get(geoid);
      const val = row ? row[key] : NaN;
      const t = Number.isFinite(val) ? (val - minVal) / span : NaN;
      const isSelected = geoid === (selectedTractGeoid || activeTractRow?.GEOID);

      const path = svgNode("path", {
        d: geometryToPath(feature.geometry, project),
        fill: interpolateColor(t),
        class: `map-feature${isSelected ? " is-active" : ""}`
      });
      const title = svgNode("title");
      title.textContent = `${row?.short_name || feature.properties.tract_name}: ${format(val, meta.kind)}`;
      path.append(title);

      path.addEventListener("mouseenter", () => {
        if (row) updateTractReadout(row, key, meta);
      });
      path.addEventListener("mouseleave", () => {
        updateTractReadout(
          (selectedTractGeoid && tractByGeoid.get(selectedTractGeoid)) || topTract,
          key,
          meta
        );
      });
      path.addEventListener("click", () => {
        selectedTractGeoid = geoid;
        renderTractMap(key, meta);
        renderTractRanking(key, meta);
      });

      svg.append(path);
    });

    svg.querySelectorAll(".map-feature.is-active").forEach(el => svg.append(el));
    stage.replaceChildren(svg);
  }

  function renderTrend(key, meta) {
    const width = 900;
    const height = 330;
    const pad = { top: 18, right: 24, bottom: 42, left: 76 };
    const svg = svgNode("svg", {
      viewBox: `0 0 ${width} ${height}`,
      role: "presentation",
      preserveAspectRatio: "none"
    });

    const cName = countyName(selectedCountyGeoid);
    const lines = [
      { id: selectedCountyGeoid, label: cName, color: "#d65b42" },
      { id: "12", label: "State of Florida", color: "#287a78" },
      { id: "1", label: "United States", color: "#6684a5" }
    ];

    // If population or foreign_born count is selected, state/US totals are on a different scale;
    // plot only the selected county so the county curve isn't flattened.
    const activeLines = meta.kind === "number" ? [lines[0]] : lines;

    const series = activeLines.map(item => ({
      ...item,
      rows: rowsForGeoid(item.id, key)
    }));
    const values = series.flatMap(item => item.rows.map(row => row[key]));
    const minValue = values.length ? Math.min(...values) : 0;
    const maxValue = values.length ? Math.max(...values) : 1;
    const spread = maxValue - minValue || Math.abs(maxValue) * 0.1 || 1;
    const low = Math.max(0, minValue - spread * 0.12);
    const high = maxValue + spread * 0.12;
    const x = year => pad.left + (year - 2010) / (2024 - 2010) * (width - pad.left - pad.right);
    const y = value => height - pad.bottom - (value - low) / (high - low) * (height - pad.top - pad.bottom);

    for (let tick = 0; tick <= 4; tick += 1) {
      const value = low + (high - low) * tick / 4;
      const lineY = y(value);
      svg.append(svgNode("line", { x1: pad.left, x2: width - pad.right, y1: lineY, y2: lineY, class: "grid-line" }));
      const label = svgNode("text", { x: pad.left - 12, y: lineY + 4, "text-anchor": "end", class: "axis-label" });
      label.textContent = format(value, meta.kind, true);
      svg.append(label);
    }

    [2010, 2012, 2015, 2018, 2021, 2024].forEach(year => {
      const label = svgNode("text", { x: x(year), y: height - 12, "text-anchor": "middle", class: "axis-label" });
      label.textContent = year;
      svg.append(label);
    });

    series.forEach(({ label, color, rows }) => {
      if (!rows.length) return;
      const path = rows.map((row, index) => `${index ? "L" : "M"}${x(row.year)},${y(row[key])}`).join(" ");
      svg.append(svgNode("path", { d: path, class: "trend-line", stroke: color }));
      rows.forEach(row => {
        svg.append(svgNode("circle", {
          cx: x(row.year),
          cy: y(row[key]),
          r: row.year === Number(slider.value) ? 5 : 2.5,
          fill: color,
          class: "trend-point"
        }));
      });
    });

    const chart = document.getElementById("trend-chart");
    chart.replaceChildren(svg);

    const legend = document.getElementById("trend-legend");
    legend.replaceChildren();
    activeLines.forEach(({ label, color }) => {
      const item = document.createElement("span");
      item.className = "legend-item";
      const swatch = document.createElement("i");
      swatch.style.backgroundColor = color;
      item.append(swatch, document.createTextNode(label));
      legend.append(item);
    });
  }

  function renderTractRanking(key, meta) {
    const cName = countyName(selectedCountyGeoid);
    text("comparison-heading", `Top Census tracts in ${cName}`);

    const tracts = tractsData
      .filter(r => r.county_geoid === selectedCountyGeoid && Number.isFinite(r[key]))
      .sort((a, b) => b[key] - a[key])
      .slice(0, 15);

    const maxValue = Math.max(...tracts.map(r => r[key]), 1);
    const list = document.getElementById("comparison-chart");
    list.replaceChildren();

    tracts.forEach((tract, index) => {
      const isSelected = tract.GEOID === selectedTractGeoid || (!selectedTractGeoid && index === 0);
      const row = document.createElement("div");
      row.className = `comparison-row is-clickable${isSelected ? " is-sarasota" : ""}`;

      const name = document.createElement("span");
      name.className = "comparison-name";
      name.textContent = tract.short_name;

      const track = document.createElement("span");
      track.className = "bar-track";
      const bar = document.createElement("i");
      bar.className = "bar-fill";
      bar.style.width = `${Math.max(1, tract[key] / maxValue * 100)}%`;
      bar.style.backgroundColor = isSelected ? "#d65b42" : "#287a78";
      track.append(bar);

      const amount = document.createElement("strong");
      amount.className = "comparison-value";
      amount.textContent = format(tract[key], meta.kind, true);

      row.append(name, track, amount);
      row.addEventListener("click", () => {
        selectedTractGeoid = tract.GEOID;
        renderTractMap(key, meta);
        renderTractRanking(key, meta);
      });
      list.append(row);
    });
  }

  function updateComparisonCard(targetId, detailId, countyVal, refVal, refLabel, meta) {
    if (!Number.isFinite(refVal) || !Number.isFinite(countyVal)) {
      text(targetId, "—");
      text(detailId, `${refLabel} comparison unavailable`);
      return;
    }
    text(targetId, format(refVal, meta.kind, true));
    const diffText = meta.kind === "number"
      ? `County is ${(countyVal / refVal * 100).toFixed(2)}% of ${refLabel} total`
      : meta.kind === "percent"
        ? `County is ${countyVal - refVal > 0 ? "+" : ""}${(countyVal - refVal).toFixed(1)} pts vs. ${refLabel}`
        : `County is ${signed((countyVal / refVal - 1) * 100)} vs. ${refLabel}`;
    text(detailId, diffText);
  }

  function update() {
    const year = Number(slider.value);
    const key = metricSelect.value;
    const meta = metrics[key];
    const cName = countyName(selectedCountyGeoid);
    const current = rowAtGeoid(selectedCountyGeoid, year)?.[key];
    const series = rowsForGeoid(selectedCountyGeoid, key);
    const first = series[0];
    const selected = series.find(row => row.year === year);

    text("year-label", year);
    text("current-label", `${cName.toUpperCase()} · ${year}`);
    text("metric-name", meta.label);

    if (Number.isFinite(current)) {
      text("current-value", format(current, meta.kind));
      if (selected && first && first[key] !== 0) {
        const changeStr = meta.kind === "percent"
          ? `${selected[key] - first[key] > 0 ? "+" : ""}${(selected[key] - first[key]).toFixed(1)} pts`
          : signed((selected[key] / first[key] - 1) * 100);
        text("change-value", changeStr);
        text("change-detail", `Since ${first.year} (${format(first[key], meta.kind)})`);
      } else {
        text("change-value", "—");
        text("change-detail", "Baseline unavailable");
      }
    } else {
      text("current-value", "Not available");
      text("change-value", "—");
      text("change-detail", meta.start ? `Available from ${meta.start}` : "No estimate available");
    }

    const floridaVal = rowAtGeoid("12", year)?.[key];
    const usVal = rowAtGeoid("1", year)?.[key];
    updateComparisonCard("state-value", "state-detail", current, floridaVal, "Florida", meta);
    updateComparisonCard("us-value", "us-detail", current, usVal, "U.S.", meta);

    text("year-note", `ACS ${year - 4}–${year} five-year estimate · Click any Florida county on the map to explore its Census tracts`);
    document.getElementById("year-note").classList.toggle("is-unavailable", !Number.isFinite(current));

    renderCountyMap(key, meta, year);
    renderTractMap(key, meta);
    renderTrend(key, meta);
    renderTractRanking(key, meta);
  }

  // Load Florida Census tract polygons asynchronously
  fetch("county/florida_tracts.geojson")
    .then(r => r.json())
    .then(geo => {
      tractsGeo = geo;
      const key = metricSelect.value;
      renderTractMap(key, metrics[key]);
    })
    .catch(() => {
      text("county-tract-map", "Could not load tract boundary file.");
    });

  slider.addEventListener("input", update);
  countySelect.addEventListener("change", () => {
    selectedCountyGeoid = countySelect.value;
    selectedTractGeoid = null;
    update();
  });
  metricSelect.addEventListener("change", update);

  playButton.addEventListener("click", () => {
    if (playTimer) {
      clearInterval(playTimer);
      playTimer = undefined;
      playButton.classList.remove("is-playing");
      playButton.setAttribute("aria-label", "Play through years");
      text("play-label", "Play");
      playButton.querySelector("[aria-hidden='true']").textContent = "▶";
      return;
    }
    if (Number(slider.value) >= Number(slider.max)) slider.value = slider.min;
    playButton.classList.add("is-playing");
    playButton.setAttribute("aria-label", "Pause years");
    text("play-label", "Pause");
    playButton.querySelector("[aria-hidden='true']").textContent = "Ⅱ";
    playTimer = setInterval(() => {
      const next = Number(slider.value) + 1;
      if (next > Number(slider.max)) {
        playButton.click();
        return;
      }
      slider.value = next;
      update();
    }, 850);
  });

  update();
})();
</script>
